visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a person's hand resting on a white table. Another person with brown-patterned manicured nails applies a white liquid base to the back of the hand using a wand applicator. A smartphone displaying a tattoo image lies nearby. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the skin texture and the white substance. (2) A black eyeliner pen is introduced, drawing a circle on the hand over the white base. The camera remains steady in a close-up framing. Inset images of the character Baymax and various text overlays appear. The person's hand stays relatively static as the drawing progresses. (3) The drawing is refined into a smiley face. The person uses a cotton swab to carefully clean the edges of the drawing. More reference images of back tattoos and decorative wings appear as overlays. The surrounding environment remains the white table surface in a studio or home setting. (4) The finished 'fake tattoo' is showcased as the person moves their hand under the light, revealing a slightly glittery or reflective finish. They hold the smartphone next to the hand to compare the result with the source image. High-density captions and celebratory variety-show text pop up at the bottom of the screen.
